name: Cantrosian
description: The Cantrosians were sapient felinoids indigenous to Cantros 7. Scratches from their paws would result in Cantrosian-scratch fever. During the Galactic Civil War, the Cantrosians were staunch supporters of the Rebel Alliance, which led to an internecine conflict when a rogue operative tried to play factions against each other by insinuating Imperial sympathies among certain Cantrosian groups.
